guitar.modelsText: Gretsch Duo Jet / Rickenbacker 360/12 / Fender Stratocaster "Rocky"
guitar.evidence: George Harrison's guitars are extremely well documented: Gretsch Duo Jet (early Beatles), Rickenbacker 360/12 twelve-string (jangle sound), and his painted Fender Stratocaster nicknamed 'Rocky' (later solo era).
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown; iconic and well-documented gear history.

tone.target: slide guitar with compressed clean tone and subtle Leslie-like modulation

tone.summary: A warm, compressed Fender-style signal chain utilizing a light overdrive and Chorus (as a proxy for the Leslie effect) into a clean US Deluxe amp setup.
